jd:
SWIVEL, an SWBC software technology company is seeking talented Computer Science students to join our College Intern Program. This is an exciting opportunity for college students who are motivated and eager to learn within their educational field of study.

Interns will gain practical hands-on experience and training that will provide an opportunity for growth, learning and development within the financial services industry. Full-time and part-time paid internship opportunities will be available with our DevOps team. Interns will be placed within a specific team based on interest, experience, academic coursework, SWIVEL’s business need, and flexibility with college/university schedule.

Why You'll Love This Role

As a SWIVEL Intern, you will be learning on the job in real-time from talented quality engineering professionals within the financial services industry. We will develop, teach, mentor, and support your efforts throughout the internship. Our interns are given projects that are impactful and meaningful to SWIVEL, so interns will feel they are a valued team member of our SWIVEL family.

Essential Duties Include The Following



- This internship is ideal for students looking to gain experience in DevOps, software operations, and enterprise IT management
- Assists with building systems to interface with SWIVEL clientele and tools to eliminate repetitive tasks.
- Work alongside the DevOps team as part of their team
- Builds awareness and gain exposure to the Financial Services Industry while growing your talents.
- Learns key technical skills to apply acquired knowledge and assist in problem solving.
- Gains practical, hands-on experience that will provide an opportunity for growth.
- Works alongside and shadow team members while expanding your knowledge base with the ability to further develop your skills.
- Assist with ad hoc projects. 

Serious Candidates Will Possess The Minimum Qualifications



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related program at an accredited university/college.
- Experience with Java and C# preferred.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong analytical and interpersonal skills required.
- Detail oriented and possess excellent follow up skills.
- Organized and adapt well to change.
- Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment.
- Passion and desire for learning and a proactive energy for getting things done.
- Display maturity and a high level of professionalism. 

SWIVEL offers*: 



- Competitive overall compensation package
- Work/Life balance 
- Employee engagement activities and recognition awards 
- Years of Service awards
- Career enhancement and growth opportunities 
- Leadership Academy and Mentor Program
- Continuing education and career certifications 
- Variety of healthcare coverage options
- Traditional and Roth 401(k) retirement plans 
- Lucrative Wellness Program
- Based upon employee eligibility 

Additional Information

SWIVEL is a Substance-Free Workplace and requires pre-employment drug testing.

Please note, SWIVEL does not hire tobacco users as allowed by law.

To learn more about SWIVEL, visit our website at https://www.getswivel.io/. If interested, please click the appropriate apply button.

role: Technical Co-op I: Software Development Intern
jd:
Standard Job Description

As a Software Developer Intern you will be working on mission critical software for the control and analytics of Unmanned Vehicles and Systems.

Lockheed Martin Canada CDL Systems software is deployed globally in Small (SUAS), Medium (Shadow RQ-7), Large (Grey Eagle MQ-1C), and high altitude pseudo satellite (HAPS) systems as well as surface vehicles and target systems.

As part of the Skunkworks team, you'll have the opportunity to work on cutting edge next generation ground control system platforms as well as computer vision and AI applications in the air and on the ground.

We're looking for a developer to work primarily in C++ (with some tooling scripting) engineering systems in collaborative self-organizing Scrum teams, practicing test driven development, with the freedom to create the solution that actually fits the problem at hand.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing reliable, mission critical, cross platform software, this includes:



- Develop the solution (primarily in C++) using test driven development. Responsible for writing tests from unit level to system end-to-end
- Engineer solutions that provide optimal user experience 
- Participate in agile practices like estimation meetings, retrospectives, standups, etc.
- Develop, maintain and document the architecture of the solution
- Contribution to documentation, delivery, and deployment of the solution
- Assist our customer experience team support the solution

Duties May Also Include



- Opportunities to travel for on-site integration, training, flight trials
- Opportunities to participate in local (Calgary area) LM CDL flight testing operations
- Assisting LM CDL’s tooling team maintain industry best software development tools and techniques
- Voluntary participation on LM CDL’s social committee

Basic Qualifications

This is a 16-month internship position available engineering students who have completed their third year. This position will be of interest to students who are in:



- Software Engineering;
- Computer Engineering;
- Geomatics Engineering;
- Electrical Engineering (with a Computer Minor program); or,
- Computer Science.

Experience, Skills And Talents



- Object-Oriented software design
- Experience with the C++ programming language
- Software development experience on Linux and Microsoft Windows
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Some familiarity with agile software development process and test driven software development
- Enjoys working in a collaborative team environment
- Continually learn and improve based on focused feedback.

Desired Skills

While not required to apply for this position, the following skills and experience align with Lockheed Martin Skunk Works' core business competencies and our future growth areas.



- Experience in the Uncrewed Vehicle (UV) domain
- Experience and a desire to help our organization increase diversity, equity, and inclusion. 
- Android development experience 
- Experience with the ArduPilot auto pilot and/or the Mavlink vehicle communications protocol
- Experience with the STANAG-4586 vehicle communications protocol
- Experience with development and testing of of Artificial Intelligence software
- Experience with Computer Vision software solutions
fit_why: Primary C++ and embedded-adjacent UV control; minimal overlap with web stack

jd:
WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.
 As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.
 We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.
 This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.
 We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.
 Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

This posting supports current and anticipated early-career hiring needs. Applying allows our recruiting team to consider you for opportunities that align with your qualifications, preferences, and availability. An immediate opening or interview is not guaranteed. 
 Where are these roles located?  You’ll have the opportunity to work with teams in:
 
• Colorado Springs, Colorado 
• Irvine, California 
• Longmont, Colorado 
• Fremont, California 
• Rochester, Minnesota 
• San Jose, California System Tools Software Intern : 
 Build the software behind the technology. 
 As a System Tools Software Intern , you'll create the software that powers engineering teams and next-generation products. You'll design, develop, test, and improve tools that make systems faster, more reliable, and easier to build.
 In this role, you may:
 
• Design and develop system software, utilities, and engineering tools. 
• Build or enhance operating systems, compilers, networking tools, databases, and Internet-based applications. 
• Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize software performance. 
• Collaborate with hardware and software engineers to ensure seamless integration. 
• Help influence hardware design by developing software that works efficiently with new technologies. Applications Software Intern: 
 Create software that helps teams work smarter. 
 As an Applications Software Engineer , you'll develop applications that support employees, customers, and business operations. You'll design, build, test, and improve software used across enterprise systems.
 In this role, you may:
 
• Design, develop, and maintain commercial and internal software applications. 
• Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using modern programming languages. 
• Test, debug, and improve application performance. 
• Collaborate with teammates to build new features and solve technical problems. 
• Create documentation that supports software deployment and ongoing maintenance. Data Analytics Intern : 
 Turn data into insights that drive better decisions. 
 As a Data Analytics Engineer , you'll build the tools and data systems that help teams understand performance, improve products, and solve business challenges. You'll work with large datasets to create meaningful insights that influence engineering and business decisions.
 In this role, you may:
 
• Design and develop data pipelines, databases, and data warehouses. 
• Build software and automation tools for collecting, processing, and analyzing data. 
• Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that support decision-making. 
• Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions. 
• Analyze data to identify trends, improve processes, and solve complex problems. Firmware Engineering Intern : 
 Write the code that brings hardware to life. 
 As a Firmware Intern , you'll develop the low-level software that allows hardware devices to function. Working at the intersection of hardware and software, you'll help build reliable, high-performance embedded systems used in next-generation technology.
 In this role, you may:
 
• Design, develop, test, and debug embedded firmware. 
• Write software using C, C++, assembly, and other low-level programming languages. 
• Collaborate with hardware engineers to integrate software with electronic systems. 
• Troubleshoot firmware and hardware interactions to improve performance and reliability. 
• Support new product development from concept through production. This role is part of WD's early career development program. WD's early career development program is ideal for individuals at the early stages of their professional career.  Participants receive foundational training through structured onboarding, mentorship, and a curated development curriculum. The responsibilities of this role are typically aligned with candidates who have approximately 0–2+ years of relevant professional experience, though candidates of all experience levels are encouraged to apply.
 Systems Design & Integration Intern: 
 Bring complex systems together. 
 As a Systems Design & Integration Engineer , you'll help ensure hardware and software work together seamlessly. You'll collaborate across engineering teams to design, integrate, test, and optimize complete system solutions for next-generation products.
 In this role, you may:
 
• Define system requirements and technical specifications. 
• Evaluate hardware and software compatibility. 
• Coordinate the integration of multiple subsystems into complete products. 
• Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve system-level issues. 
• Recommend improvements that enhance system performance, reliability, and scalability.

Required: 
 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. 
• Experience developing technical skills through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects using one or more programming languages such as C, C++, Python, Java, Go (Golang), SQL, JavaScript, or similar technologies . 
• Familiarity with software development fundamentals, debugging, data structures, algorithms, operating systems, or other computer engineering concepts. 
• Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with a passion for learning new technologies. 
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment. 
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and common software development tools (such as Git, Linux, or IDEs) is a plus. 
• Interest in storage technologies, semiconductors, embedded systems, cloud computing, AI, data analytics, or other emerging technologies.

jd:
The Assurant Internship Program is a 12-week immersive experience where interns do not sit on the sidelines. You will gain real-world experience by tackling business challenges and helping drive meaningful outcomes. The program combines hands-on work with learning and development opportunities, mentorship, networking and engagement opportunities, and resources designed to support your professional growth.

 Do you want to join a team that helps people protect the things that matter the most to them? Are you interested in discovering how to apply the skills you’re learning in school to solve real-world challenges? Are you looking for a well-rounded experience that enables and encourages continuous learning and participation in corporate social responsibility initiatives?  
  
 Assurant is looking for summer 2027 Software Engineering Interns!  
  
 The internship is designed for current students and soon to be college graduates to gain a well-rounded introduction to and experience in Information Technology.  The internship will focus on principles of Agile Application Development and will equip you with transferrable skills that can help you anywhere you go.  
  
 The program is a paid internship consisting of one semester focused in software engineering, application development, code quality, and automation.  You will paired with technical and leadership mentors throughout the internship, giving you access to work on the things that you are the most passionate about. You will be engaged in immersive learning experiences, from Dojos to tech talks, with the opportunity to showcase your work with our leadership.   

 We’ll provide learning opportunities to further your development with concepts to include:  
 
• Plan, Develop, and Support applications in various languages and disciplines   
• Collaborate with product owners, engineers, designers and business partners to ensure that development work will meet the needs and expectations of the business   
• Research, solve for, and engage others as necessary to design solutions that will result in the desired business outcome    
• Ability to work and think independently    
• Work through and aid in production issues for applications supported by the department or functional area   
• Prepare documentation on work produced to ensure a smooth handoff to other team members, as needed    You bring your experience, knowledge & skills:   
 
• Positive attitude and willingness to learn   
• Project or Team Work   
• Presentations & Tech challenges   
• Creative problem solver   
• Ability to demonstrate logical thinking   
• Community Involvement:   
• Clubs or troops   
• Volunteering engagements   
• Community support   Skillset Requirements   
 
• Assurant has a vast technology stack and we’re looking to find a best technical skillset fit.  Below are the different technologies Assurant utilizes and will help us best identify a team.  Please have coursework or example code relevant to the below areas   
• AI usage with CoPilot, Claude, and/or Rovo building skills and agents   
• Internal and External integrations for authentication and authorization utilizing webhooks and service accounts   
• Observability tooling such as Datadog and Dynatrace   
• Azure or AWS Cloud Hosting   
• Azure DevOps or Jira Project Management tooling   
• Development languages and frameworks such as .NET, React, Angular, Android, iOS, Oracle, and QA Automation   Education:   
 
• Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Development, Information Systems or a related program at an accredited university. Interns will have at least one semester remaining following the summer internship. 
• You have an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2029 
 Hybrid Opportunity: Miami, Atlanta or Chicago (team dependent) 
 Paid Internship: $20 - $25/hour 
 Start Date: 5/17/2027
End Date: 8/7/2027 

 Pay Range:
$0.00 - $0.00
 Any posted pay range considers a wide range of compensation factors, including candidate background, experience and work location, while also allowing for salary growth within the position.

 If there is no posting end date listed then this is a pipeline requisition, and we will continue to collect applications on an ongoing basis.

 Helping People Thrive in a Connected World 
Connect with us. Bring us your best work and your brightest ideas. And we’ll bring you a place where you can thrive. Learn more at  jobs.assurant.com .

 For U.S. benefit information, visit  myassurantbenefits.com . For benefit information outside the U.S., please speak with your recruiter.

 What’s the culture like at Assurant? 
Our unique culture is a big reason why talented people choose Assurant. Named a Best/Great Place to Work in 14 countries and awarded the Fortune America’s Most Innovative Companies recognition, we bring together top talent around the world. Although we have a wide variety of skills and experiences, we share common characteristics that are uniquely Assurant. A passion for service. An ability to innovate in practical ways. And a willingness to take chances. We call our culture  The Assurant Way .

 Company Overview 
Assurant is a leading global business services company that supports, protects, and connects major consumer purchases. A Fortune 500 company with a presence in 21 countries, Assurant supports the advancement of the connected world by partnering with the world’s leading brands to develop innovative solutions and deliver an enhanced customer experience through mobile device solutions, extended service contracts, vehicle protection services, renters insurance, lender-placed insurance products, and other specialty products.

 AI and Biometric Usage 
 Assurant supports the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI), but we want to know the real you. Visit our AI Usage Guidelines page to understand what we expect from applicants regarding their use of AI during the application process. Since we would like to know the real you, we require that all of our virtual interviews be conducted on video.
  
 Employment is contingent upon completion of a required identity verification process, which may include biometric technology, where permitted by applicable law and subject to applicable notice and consent requirements. See our Privacy Notice to learn about Assurant’s privacy practices, including our use of AI-enabled technology, automated decision making, and biometric information.

 Equal Opportunity Statement 
Assurant is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not use or consider race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law in employment decisions.

 Job Scam Alert 
Please be aware that during Assurant's application process, we will never ask for personal information such as your Social Security number, bank account details, or passwords. Learn more about what to look out for and how to report a scam here .

 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
 
 As an IT Software Engineer Intern at Micron, you will create software that contributes to a suite of applications supporting Micron’s Business Data Warehouse. Join our professional and innovative team to experience the entire software development lifecycle working as a full-stack software engineer to provide high-value solutions so the power of data and analytics can be harnessed.  

 Responsibilities: 
 
• Collaboration with a motivated and inclusive software development team  
• Utilizing the software development lifecycle to deliver quality-driven solutions  
• Communication with internal stakeholders and a diverse worldwide IT team to create solutions that fit customer needs and add value to the business  
• Design and develop utilities, tools and framework to support the data factory  
 Minimum Qualifications:
 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (Master’s preferred). Must be graduating no sooner than June 2027. 
• Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, databases (relational, NoSQL, graph), and SQL. 
• Proficiency in object-oriented programming and languages such as C# and Python, with an understanding of software architecture concepts. 
• Ability to quickly learn new technologies and programming languages while managing priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
• Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills, with a basic understanding of agentic AI. 
 Preferred Qualifications:
 
• Knowledge of Snowflake database. 
• Knowledge about Data visualization with Tableau/Power BI. 
• Knowledge of AI enabled code generation/review. 
• Knowledge of web frontend technologies like JavaScript, react etc.  
• Self-motivated and team oriented. 
 
 As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future.  We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget.  Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.  Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays.   For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits .

INVENT. IMPROVE. INSPIRE.  
 Fresenius Medical Care is not your typical medical products company. We are a close-knit team of talented professionals driven by a shared commitment: to lead a movement to dramatically improve renal care with innovative yet simple therapeutic solutions that benefit patients, caregivers, and society. We pursue this goal through a passionate commitment to Innovate, Educate, and Advocate for the breakthroughs that are redefining renal care. Additionally, Fresenius Medical Care works in community with its customers, patients, industry partners, and government leaders and agencies to realize the vision of better, simpler, more accessible renal care.   
   
 Position Summary:   
 Join a multidisciplinary team developing AI-powered engineering tools for medical device development. This role focuses on transforming complex engineering information into structured knowledge that can be queried, analyzed, and reasoned about using modern AI techniques.   
   
 The selected intern will assist in developing next gen tools and process to accelerate SW development in the Home HD Embedded SW group.  The role will report to the Sr Manager Application Development, Home Hemodialysis. The intern will work collaboratively with several cross-functional departments including Digital Solutions, Systems Engineering, Software Test, and SQA as part of this role.   
   
 Responsibilities:   
 
• Process and organize engineering documentation, including product requirements, software requirements, test plans, verification reports, and related design-control artifacts.    
• Assist in developing AI-driven systems that enable engineers to ask natural-language questions about product functionality, requirements, verification activities, and traceability.    
• Work with engineering and AI teams to construct structured representations of software systems from development artifacts.   
• Help integrate software-derived knowledge with design documentation to create a unified engineering knowledge base.    
• Support development of retrieval, search, analytics, and agentic AI capabilities that connect software implementation details with requirements, testing, and system design information.    
• Collaborate with software, systems, and AI engineers to improve access to technical knowledge across the product lifecycle.     
 Education & Qualifications:   
 
• Candidate for Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related technical field.   
• A background or strong interest in Cognitive Science/Psychology, given the empathetic persona development focus.   
• LLM Fundamentals: Solid understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).   
• Programming: Proficiency in Python (specifically libraries like Pandas, NumPy, or frameworks like LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph).   
• Data Management: Experience organizing unstructured data and working with Knowledge Bases or Vector DBs. (ChromaDB, FAISS, etc)   
• QA: Familiarity with software testing methodologies; experience testing AI outputs for bias or hallucination is highly desirable.   
• Demonstrated ability to conduct self-driven research, and eagerness to learn new tools and methods quickly   
• Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS or other cloud platforms, at least familiarity is needed   
• Entry level knowledge of Dialysis industry helpful, but not required    
• Energetic, curious, learner/growth/problem solver mindset, positive attitude, and enjoys working in teams   Fresenius Medical Care is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, parental status, national origin, age, disability, military service, or other non-merit-based factors
